entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. Finally. I need to return this helmet and I need to do it NOW.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is David. I can certainly help you with that. May I have your name and order number, please?
It's Alex Serrano, order number 774-B-91. I've had it with this thing sitting in my closet. I want my money back.
Thank you, Alex. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the Urban Commuter Helmet. To make sure I understand the situation correctly, what specifically is the issue with the helmet?
The issue is I don't want it! The color is all wrong, it's not what I expected. The box is still unopened, it's brand new. This is a simple return, don't make this difficult.
I understand completely. I just need to check the purchase date against our return policy. One moment while I review your account.
What is there to review?! Are you trying to find a reason to deny me? I swear, if you give me the runaround, I'll be posting about this everywhere. Get me your manager, right now!

There's no need for a manager, Alex, I can resolve this for you. I've just confirmed your order date. You are well within our 90-day return period. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund.
Oh. So you can do it? Then why all the questions and the delay? Just process it.

Of course. It's just a standard verification step to ensure everything is correct. Your safety and satisfaction are important to us. I have just initiated the return, and a prepaid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. Just attach that to the package and drop it off.
Fine. As long as it gets done. Don't waste my time again.
You will receive a confirmation once we receive the helmet and process your refund. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. Just make sure that email shows up.
It has already been sent. Thank you for your call, Alex. Have a good day.
